description: What it does BookMeIn.Events is a simple yet powerful platform designed to create, sell, and manage events of any kind—whether in-person, virtual, or hybrid. It allows organizers to build custom event pages, manage ticket sales (free or paid), and handle attendee check-ins without requiring any technical skills. Key benefits - **Zero Fees for Free Events:** Host community meetups or free workshops with 0% platform fees. - **AI-Powered Support:** Automate attendee inquiries with an integrated AI
